metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2006 · The Host
metas.description: A monster emerges from Seoul's Han River and begins attacking people. One victim's loving family does what it can to rescue her from its clutches.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2012 · Deranged
metas.description: People binge eat and suffer from extreme thirst, which leads them to go crazy for water. They cannot control themselves because they are brainwashed by a parasite.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2019 · Zombie for Sale
metas.description: When a pharmaceutical company's illegal experiments inadvertently create a zombie, the strange Park family finds it and tries to profit from it.

metas.name: ★ 6.1 · 2010 · Haunters
metas.description: Cho-In can control other people's minds when they are within his field of sight.Except one man.
